column1: # ADR-044 (accepted by Eli, 2026-10-19): the plugins whose Papyrus scripts skymp5-client admits through its event block in a connected game.
# lab/tools/papyrus-map.py turns each row into one line of mods/papyrus-scripts.txt (the plugin, then its script class names) at every persist-mods build.
# source layer: the plugin comes from a layer folder (lab/layer/load-order.tsv names it); names from its VMAD records and the folder's .pex files.
# source game: one of the game's own plugins (the Creation Club set the clones carry); names from its VMAD records, the file pulled off the host's persist esm directory into lab/.cache/game.

column3: the first admitted plugin (thuum-magnus, 2026-10-19): Survival Mode's needs and its start check are its own quest scripts, which the block kept from running (x-survival-why 20261020-020729); its compiled scripts live in the game's own BSA, so only its VMAD names are read. Measured (numidium, x-survival-unblock3 20261020-024406, screenshot 012-c1.png): with the block lifted and SurvivalModeMainQuest restarted, its 5 s check ran (a0f = 1) and the Creation's own "Enable Survival Mode? Yes / No" box appeared connected, so admitting these names from the game's first tick is enough; the first measured case of ADR-044's list working
